name: Magic Quarter
summary: In the Undercity's northeast, Forsaken spellcasters study arcane and fel arts. The Temple of the Damned anchors their work.

sections.title: A Conclave of Dark Arts
sections.body: In the Undercity's northeastern quadrant, Forsaken mages preserve arcane learning and explore darker arts. The Temple of the Damned dominates the district, a Scourge-built structure now used by the free-willed undead. Beneath its vaulted ceilings, mages shape magical energies while warlocks commune with demons. Their work makes the quarter a center of study and occult research in Lordaeron.

sections.title: Scholars, Weavers, and Summoners
sections.body: Spellcasters also come here for training and craft. Portal trainers maintain routes across Horde territories, and master tailors shape magically infused fabrics into robes and shrouds. In Dalaran, academic wizardry and forbidden magic are kept apart; Forsaken practitioners study arcane and fel power openly in the same halls, seeking strength against their many enemies.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Magic Quarter?
faq.answer: The Magic Quarter is the Forsaken center for arcane and demonic studies. Mages and warlocks train there, portal masters connect it to other cities, and tailors weave enchanted cloth.

faq.q: Why is there a Temple of the Damned in the Undercity?
aliases: why temple of the damned here
faq.answer: The Scourge raised the Temple of the Damned when they carved the Undercity beneath the ruins of Capital City. Sylvanas and her free-willed Forsaken seized the subterranean complex and repurposed its existing buildings for their spellcasters.

faq.q: Who can be trained in the Magic Quarter?
faq.answer: Mages, warlocks, and demon trainers teach in the Magic Quarter. Portal specialists and tailors also train practitioners in transport and craft.

faq.q: Where is the Magic Quarter located?
faq.answer: The Magic Quarter occupies the Undercity's northeastern quadrant, across the central ring from the Apothecarium.

angles.text: As a mage, you can study arcane arts in the Magic Quarter and learn teleportation routes linking the Undercity with the wider Horde.
As a warlock, you can summon demonic minions and hone shadow magic in the Temple of the Damned, away from the Alliance's judgment.
